Game Overview

In Infinite Ascent, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an exhilarating vertical journey in Infinite Ascent, where timing and perception are key. Navigate through platforms and gaps while collecting rewards in an ever-rising tower ascent. Test your skills in gravity-defying challenges and strategic shoots, aiming to conquer endless heights and survive the climb.
